messages:
maya: Quick PR to add a troubleshooting note: fallback from streaming to single-response when clients hit repeated 429s. Draft PR #5301

jorge: include Retry-After and recommend full jitter + exp backoff. Keep Node/Python examples short.

isa: QA can run dev-sim if you add curl and a tiny harness to log status + headers.

maya: added curl and 6-line node harness, plus a one-line remediation map (429->backoff+batch, 408->increase timeout, 413->trim context).

jorge: call out Dedicated vs Private nuance in one sentence. Also link err-ref/429 and err-ref/context-limit.

docs-bot: PR opened by maya: #5301 — reviewers requested: @jorge @isa

isa: running sim now, will paste results in follow-up thread.
